messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — we’re running an Embedded Solutions SI bootcamp the week of Apr 19. Goal: 2-day hands-on with Redwood Private + HW partners for SI engineers. RSVP here: https://tiny.red/si-bootcamp-rsvp Trainers needed: 3. Cohort target: 12-16. Who can lead the 'private deploy' module?
raj: I can take private deploy basics + VPC setup. Will need a lab with 4 GPUs and sample data.
taylor: I’ll own model onboarding, quantization recs, and evals. Can we get an Nvidia partner to loan 2x A10 nodes for the hands-on? @ana any vendor contacts?
ana: Looping in @sara-hw (vendor-relations). Sara — can you check OrbitX and Aurora on short-term loaner nodes and freight/insurance? Also we need marketplace collateral for a joint listing + announcement.
sara-hw: Pinged OrbitX. They tentatively confirmed 2 A10s for week of 19th — need exact shipping address and contact. Aurora asked for an MOU; I’ll follow up.
dev-ops: FYI sandbox request form created: /forms/si-bootcamp-sandbox (approval required). Suggested config: ```size: 4xA10
image: rw/si-bootcamp:2026-04
network: private-vpc-sandbox-01``` Please file infra ticket.
marie: Love it. Action items: raj = lab infra spec (RAM, disk, dataset link), taylor = curriculum draft by 4/1, lina-enablement = certification exam outline, sara-hw = hardware confirmation + logistics, dev-ops = pre-provision sandbox. Can we get proctoring for the cert?
lina-enablement: We can run an online proctored cert (60 min, pass/fail). I’ll draft 6 prompt-based evals and two hands-on tasks. Need sample agent outputs to create rubrics.
marie: Pricing: free for top 5 SI partners, $500/person for others. Agree?
raj: Agree. Keeps barrier low for strategic partners.
ana: For the marketplace joint listing we'll need a 1-pager + co-branded assets + a short release note. Marketing ok to own the blog draft? @ben-marketing
ben-marketing: Yes — I’ll draft blog + hero assets. ETA 4/8 for first pass. Can someone share two customer use-cases we can call out?
taylor: I can surface a partner success blurb from the XCorp POC we ran. Will DM copy.
marie: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/si-bootcamp-week-of-19 (dev-bot: event created).
dev-bot: calendar event 1719993000 created by marie.
marie: Quick sync tomorrow 10:00am — 15min standup to confirm progress. Please mark RSVP in calendar.
lina-enablement: RSVP’d.
raj: RSVP’d.
ana: RSVP’d.
ben-marketing: RSVP’d.
sara-hw: RSVP’d.
taylor: RSVP’d.
marie: Thanks team — I added Asana tasks: ASANA-4571 (curriculum draft), ASANA-4572 (infra provisioning), ASANA-4573 (cert authoring). Please update status by EOD Friday. :rocket:
